title: Oct 28 rain alert: red for Mulugu, Kothagudem, Khammam; Hyderabad moderate rain
body: The system crosses the Andhra coast on the evening of Oct 27. Telangana feels it on Oct 28: 3 red, 5 orange and 8 yellow districts. Rain may linger into Oct 29.

steps.b: IMD shifted the crossing point south, to Machilipatnam–Visakhapatnam, on Oct 27 evening.
East and northeast Telangana get heavy to very heavy rain on Oct 28.
Track and strength get clearer once it becomes a depression.

care: Travel to Khammam or Bhadrachalam on Oct 27–28? Push it if you can.
